## Execution audit

**Provenance.** Citations below refer to expanded files under `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/fixed_h0/H0/development/`. Their archive provenance is `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/r1--fixed_h0.tar.gz`, with members under `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/fixed_h0/H0/development/` followed by the cited relative file path.

### Shipboard sleeping compartment: commons_118588033

**Code intent and representation.** The selected step’s generated script builds a compartment from individually included, serially named boxes, rods, filleted boxes and flattened balls—not a single semantic mesh. It specifies a deck, bulkheads, ceiling and beams; three groups of three-tier bunks, each with separate supports, mattresses, pillows, blankets and rails; lockers with modeled louvers; machinery, an equipment cage and a chair. It also models a telephone, notice, benches, ceiling pipes and pendant fixtures. These are scripted placements, not proof that the parts physically connect or that their image matches the reference. [X0426, `commons_118588033/steps/003/build.py`, lines 14–40, 52–94, 112–174, 176–249]

The script assigns colors to primitives, sets node-based Principled materials to roughness 0.69 and conditionally gives very bright materials emission strength 3. A dedicated deck material uses Noise scale 65 feeding Bump strength 0.13 and distance 0.025, with roughness 0.38; matching mesh names are assigned that material. These are code operations, not an independent assessment of their visible effect. [X0426, lines 262–290]

**View and render intent.** The camera is placed at (-0.05, -0.90, 1.67), aimed at (-0.20, 6, 1.69), with 25.5 mm lens and 36 mm sensor. Three pendant-area emitters use power 105 and size 0.53; two additional area lights use powers 150 and 85. The script creates a world if absent, sets background strength 0.35, and requests Cycles, 48 samples, 384 × 512 at 100%, AgX and medium-high contrast. These are script settings, not separately measured output metadata. [X0426, lines 251–260, 292–306]

**Execution sequence.** Step 1 failed before producing an image: its telephone-top fillet radius 0.10 exceeded half the smallest 0.18 dimension. Step 2 reduced that radius to 0.075 but failed at `sc.world.color` because the world was `None`; its image was also null. Step 3 explicitly creates a missing world. [X0422, `commons_118588033/steps/001/build.py`, lines 125–126; X0423, `commons_118588033/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0424, `commons_118588033/steps/002/build.py`, lines 138–141, 219–220; X0425, `commons_118588033/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0426, lines 292–298]

The run record reports completion, no runtime error, CPU execution and three executions; a separate selection file identifies step 3, although the record’s own `selected` field is null. The supplied sources do not include step 3’s result log, so the record supports reported completion but does not independently show its render-save log. [X0419, `commons_118588033/record.json`, lines 16–18, 36–38, 47–57; X0420, `commons_118588033/selected.json`, lines 1–3; X0421, `commons_118588033/status.json`, lines 1–4]

**Validation and quality.** The record reports valid=true, SSIM 0.1339, LPIPS 0.8928, DINO 0.6055, PSNR 10.7852 and overall 0.3480. Its structural, material and composite checks pass for `bunk pillow_0025`, but the record explicitly limits interpretation to structural/edit operability; semantic completeness and support-collision truth are null. These results are not independent visual acceptance or proof of contact. No images are attached for visual judgment; a completed reconstruction could still be poor. [X0419, lines 17–35]

### Separate chaise-related execution: commons_109923183

Step 3’s result reports `ok: true`, empty stderr, 16/16 samples finished, and saves both `final.png` and `scene.blend`. Its synchronization log includes named chaise mattress, upholstered wings, curved headboard, pillow, stitched welt and numerous decorative objects; names alone do not establish geometry or fidelity. The task metadata specifies a 512 × 384 reference, not measured render dimensions. No generated code, selection or acceptance record for this scene is supplied here. [X0416, `commons_109923183/steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0417, `commons_109923183/task.json`, lines 2–5]
